description: PowerSystemDataModel, published by ie3-institute, represents power-grid components, thermal units, storage, electric vehicles, load profiles and weather inputs, with CSV input-output and geographic-information handling. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: This is a model data layer and input preparation library; it is not itself a power-flow solver. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The existing SIMONA record names PowerSystemDataModel as a dependency, but does not catalogue this separate library.
